Frequently asked questions

Where is The Katabello?

The Katabello is a condominium project in Kata, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).

What is the starting price of The Katabello?

Agent advertised price is ฿3,200,000, last checked 2026-11-14. Prices and availability change, so ask us on WhatsApp for the current figures.

What ownership is offered at The Katabello?

Sources list freehold ownership. Always confirm the exact title and conditions with a Thai lawyer before buying; this is general information, not legal advice.

When will The Katabello be ready?

Current status: under construction. Dates can change, so please confirm with us.
